body:
Issue #184 / preflight REVIEW_RECORDED: https://github.com/miyazaki1016/misaki/actions/runs/43025723023

Extends PR #78 without modifying its existing branch. Adds estimated-cost stop guard ($0.04), max 14 calls, max 256 output tokens, usageMetadata accounting and fallback on failures to the existing synthetic-only quality evaluator.

Review pending: CI and isolated test validation; Gemini live run not performed. Estimated cost is not a billing cap. No real user conversations, production DB, merge or production deployment. Keep Draft until latest HEAD checks and safe live evaluation are verified.
